import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static int average(int n, List<Integer> v) {
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            total += v.get(i);
        }
        return total / n;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            v.add(sc.nextInt());
        }
        System.out.println(average(n, v));
        sc.close();
    }
}
